ucs.title: [LLM] APT33 (Peach Sandstorm) password-spray success chained with AAD persistence (device/MFA registration)
ucs.description: Hunts Microsoft's documented Peach Sandstorm 2023 chain: high-volume Entra ID password spray from a single source IP, followed by a successful sign-in from that same IP, followed within the same window by the compromised account performing AAD self-modification (device registration, new MFA method, role assignment). This three-step chain is the signature post-auth foothold APT33 uses against aerospace/defense tenants — far higher fidelity than a generic spray alert.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count as failed_attempts dc(Authentication.user) as failed_users from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=failure Authentication.app IN ("azure-ad","azuread","entra","office365","o365") Authentication.signature_id IN ("50126","50053","50055","50056","50057","50064","50076","50058","50034") by Authentication.src _time span=1h | where failed_users>=10 AND failed_attempts>=30 | rename Authentication.src as spray_src | fields spray_src | join type=inner spray_src [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as first_success from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.app IN ("azure-ad","azuread","entra","office365","o365") by Authentication.src Authentication.user | rename Authentication.src as spray_src Authentication.user as compromised_user] | join type=inner compromised_user [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Change where Change.change_type=AAA (Change.action=modified OR Change.action=created) (Change.object_category=user OR Change.object_category=device OR Change.object_category=authentication_method) by Change.user Change.action Change.object _time | rename Change.user as compromised_user Change.action as aad_action Change.object as aad_object] | where _time>=first_success AND _time<=first_success+3600 | table _time spray_src compromised_user aad_action aad_object first_success
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let SpraySources = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ErrorCode in (50126, 50053, 50055, 50056, 50057, 50064, 50076, 50058, 50034)   // bad-password / lockout / disabled / expired-pw
    | summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(AccountUpn), FailedAttempts = count()
                by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
    | where FailedAccounts >= 10 and FailedAttempts >= 30   // 10 accts / 30 attempts / hr — empirical Peach Sandstorm 2023 threshold
    | distinct IPAddress;
let Compromised = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where IPAddress in (SpraySources)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | summarize FirstSuccess = min(Timestamp) by AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, IPAddress;
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where Application == "Microsoft Azure Active Directory"
| where ActionType has_any ("Add device","Register device","Add registered owner to device","User registered security info","Add authentication phone","Update authentication method","Add member to role","Consent to application","Add app role assignment grant to user")
| extend AccountObjectId = tostring(AccountObjectId)
| join kind=inner Compromised on AccountObjectId
| where Timestamp between (FirstSuccess .. FirstSuccess + 1h)
| project Timestamp, FirstSuccess, AccountUpn, IPAddress, ActionType, ObjectName, ActivityObjects
| order by Timestamp asc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let SpraySources = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ResultType in (50126, 50053, 50055, 50056, 50057, 50064, 50076, 50058, 50034)
    | summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName), FailedAttempts = count()
                by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where FailedAccounts >= 10 and FailedAttempts >= 30
    | distinct IPAddress;
let Compromised = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where IPAddress in (SpraySources)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize FirstSuccess = min(TimeGenerated) by UserId, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where OperationName has_any ("Add device","Register device","Add registered owner to device","User registered security info","Add app role assignment","Add authentication method","Update authentication method","Consent to application","Add member to role")
| extend ActorId = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).id),
         ActorUpn = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).userPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner (Compromised | project UserId, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, FirstSuccess) on $left.ActorId == $right.UserId
| where TimeGenerated between (FirstSuccess .. FirstSuccess + 1h)
| project TimeGenerated, FirstSuccess, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, OperationName, Result, TargetResources
| order by TimeGenerated asc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:"Sign-in activity" @properties.status.errorCode:(50126 OR 50053 OR 50055 OR 50056 OR 50057 OR 50064 OR 50076 OR 50058 OR 50034)
ucs.rationale: Specifically catches the Peach Sandstorm Feb–Jul 2023 campaign Microsoft attributed to APT33/HOLMIUM. The actor's signature is not the spray itself (commodity TTP) but the same source IP completing the auth and the compromised principal immediately registering a device or new MFA method to keep access surviving credential resets. ucs.title: [LLM] APT33 / Elfin maldoc execution chain — Office spawning script host with download/encoded payload (POWERTON / FalseFont lure)
ucs.description: Hunts the APT33 spearphishing-to-stager pattern used to deliver POWERTON, TURNEDUP, and the newer FalseFont implant against aerospace/defense/energy targets: HR-themed weaponised Office docs whose macros spawn powershell.exe / wscript.exe / mshta.exe with a download cradle, base64-encoded command, or hidden-window flags. Anchored on the parent-process pivot Mandiant and FireEye documented for this group.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_id) as process_ids values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wordpad.exe","mspub.exe","visio.exe","eqnedt32.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") (Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadFile*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*" OR Processes.process="*Start-BitsTransfer*" OR Processes.process="*BitsTransfer*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*-noprofile*" OR Processes.process="*hidden*" OR Processes.process="*bypass*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wordpad.exe","mspub.exe","visio.exe","eqnedt32.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression",
    "FromBase64String","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","Net.WebClient",
    "BitsTransfer","Start-BitsTransfer","ServicePointManager","SecurityProtocol",
    "-nop","-noprofile","bypass")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(indow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let OfficeParents = dynamic([@"\winword.exe",@"\excel.exe",@"\powerpnt.exe",@"\outlook.exe",@"\wordpad.exe",@"\mspub.exe",@"\visio.exe",@"\eqnedt32.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic([@"\powershell.exe",@"\pwsh.exe",@"\wscript.exe",@"\cscript.exe",@"\mshta.exe",@"\rundll32.exe",@"\regsvr32.exe",@"\cmd.exe",@"\certutil.exe",@"\bitsadmin.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any (OfficeParents)
| where NewProcessName has_any (ScriptChildren)
| where CommandLine has_any ("DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","Net.WebClient","BitsTransfer","Start-BitsTransfer","-nop","-noprofile","bypass")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(indow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User = SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT33 Peach Sandstorm Office-to-Script Download Cradle (POWERTON/FalseFont lure)
id: 8e4b2e0a-7a3f-4d6c-9a1b-2c5d8f3b1a90
status: experimental
description: Detects the APT33 / Peach Sandstorm spearphishing maldoc execution chain — Office application spawning a Windows scripting host or LOLBin with an in-memory download cradle, base64-encoded command, or hidden-window flag. Anchors on the parent-process pivot Mandiant and Microsoft tied to APT33 POWERTON/TURNEDUP/FalseFont deliveries.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/09/14/peach-sandstorm-password-spray-campaigns-enable-intelligence-collection-at-high-value-targets/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/apt33-insights-into-iranian-cyber-espionage
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0064
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\wordpad.exe'
      - '\mspub.exe'
      - '\visio.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'BitsTransfer'
      - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
      - '-nop'
      - '-noprofile'
      - 'bypass'
      - 'hidden'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmdline
falsepositives:
  - Macro-enabled corporate templates with legitimate web fetches (rare, can be allowlisted by parent doc hash)
  - Office add-ins that legitimately shell out to PowerShell
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1) AND @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\wordpad.exe OR *\\WORDPAD.EXE OR *\\mspub.exe OR *\\MSPUB.EXE OR *\\eqnedt32.exe OR *\\EQNEDT32.EXE) AND @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *FromBase64String* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-enc\ * OR *Net.WebClient* OR *BitsTransfer* OR *hidden* OR *-nop* OR *bypass*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|wordpad|mspub|visio|eqnedt32)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(DownloadString|DownloadFile|Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-Expression|IEX|FromBase64String|-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s|Net\\.WebClient|BitsTransfer|Start-BitsTransfer|-nop|-noprofile|bypass|hidden)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen), collect([CommandLine])])
